mapper.select: SELECT s.*, ss.average_rating as averageRating, ss.total_reviews as reviewCount, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(s.latitude)))) AS distance, CASE WHEN s.status = 'OPEN' THEN true ELSE false END as isOpen FROM tb_store s LEFT JOIN tb_store_stats ss ON s.id = ss.store_id WHERE s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_store s WHERE s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT s.*, ss.average_rating as averageRating, ss.total_reviews as reviewCount, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(s.latitude)))) AS distance, CASE WHEN s.status = 'OPEN' THEN true ELSE false END as isOpen FROM tb_store s LEFT JOIN tb_store_stats ss ON s.id = ss.store_id WHERE s.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY ss.total_orders DESC, ss.average_rating DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.*, ss.average_rating as averageRating, ss.total_reviews as reviewCount, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(s.latitude)))) AS distance, CASE WHEN s.status = 'OPEN' THEN true ELSE false END as isOpen FROM tb_store s INNER JOIN tb_store_stats ss ON s.id = ss.store_id WHERE s.status = 'OPEN' AND ss.average_rating >= 4.0 AND ss.total_reviews >= 5 ORDER BY ss.average_rating DESC, ss.total_reviews DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.*, ss.average_rating as averageRating, ss.total_reviews as reviewCount, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(s.latitude)))) AS distance, CASE WHEN s.status = 'OPEN' THEN true ELSE false END as isOpen FROM tb_store s LEFT JOIN tb_store_stats ss ON s.id = ss.store_id WHERE s.status = 'OPEN' AND s.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.*, ss.average_rating as averageRating, ss.total_reviews as reviewCount, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(s.latitude)))) AS distance, CASE WHEN s.status = 'OPEN' THEN true ELSE false END as isOpen FROM tb_store s LEFT JOIN tb_store_stats ss ON s.id = ss.store_id WHERE s.status = 'OPEN' AND s.delivery_fee = 0 -- 배달비 무료인 매장 ORDER BY ss.average_rating DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.*, ss.average_rating as averageRating, ss.total_reviews as reviewCount, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(s.latitude)))) AS distance, CASE WHEN s.status = 'OPEN' THEN true ELSE false END as isOpen FROM tb_store s INNER JOIN tb_store_stats ss ON s.id = ss.store_id WHERE s.status = 'OPEN' AND s.is_featured = TRUE AND (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(s.latitude)))) <= 10 ORDER BY ss.average_rating DESC, ss.total_reviews DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.*, ss.average_rating as averageRating, ss.total_reviews as reviewCount, (6371 * acos(cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(s.latitude)) * cos(radians(s.longitude) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(s.latitude)))) AS distance, CASE WHEN s.status = 'OPEN' THEN true ELSE false END as isOpen FROM tb_store s LEFT JOIN tb_store_stats ss ON s.id = ss.store_id WHERE s.status = 'OPEN' HAVING distance <= 3 -- 3km 이내 ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT #{limit}
